## Validate resource names strictly

`is_valid_name` currently only checks length, so names with separators or whitespace slip through and later corrupt the lookup key. This tightens it to a dot-separated lowercase-alphanumeric format with a regex.

### Tests
Accepts `foo`, `foo.bar`, `a1.b2.c3`; rejects `Foo`, `foo_bar`, empty, and `foo..bar`.

    pytest tests/test_names.py
